items.text: Rams optimistic Puka Nacua (calf, Q) will play vs Raiders. Felt better Saturday; 'as long as no setbacks, feel good about him available.' MRI better than hoped.
items.why: Feeling better after limited Thursday/missed Friday; optimistic sources.
items.implication: Start with confidence if active; Adams already OUT elevates him further.
items.opportunity: High target share vs Raiders with Adams out.

items.text: Breece Hall (quad, Q) unlikely to play today vs Dolphins. May work out but not full participant yet; bit early after missing three games.
items.why: Quad strain; limited practice, not full go.
items.implication: Sit Hall; elevate handcuff/backup usage in good matchup.
items.opportunity: Full or near-full workload for Jets RB committee without him.

items.text: Lamar Jackson downgraded to OUT for Sunday vs Bengals with high ankle sprain; third straight miss. Tyler Huntley starts again.
items.why: High ankle sprain; limited practice but ruled out Saturday.
items.implication: Huntley start; fade Ravens pass game upside, monitor Henry/Andrews volume.
items.opportunity: Potential increased rushing or checkdowns for Ravens skill players.

items.text: Cam Skattebo expected to resume role as Giants lead back vs Texans; JJ McCarthy long leash.
Saquon Barkley Q but expected to play MNF vs Cowboys; DeVonta Smith OUT.
items.why: Returned to practice; expected despite Q tag.
items.implication: Start if confirmed; WR outs boost his receiving upside.
items.opportunity: Bellcow with pass-catching in high-scoring potential game.

items.text: Packers activated Josh Jacobs; expected to play Sunday at Detroit.
items.why: Activated from exempt list; expected to play.
items.implication: Immediate RB1/2 value; monitor snap share post-absence.

items.text: Eagles ruled out DeVonta Smith (and Dontayvion Wicks) for MNF vs Cowboys.
items.implication: Major target vacuum for Eagles WRs/TE; Saquon elevated if active.
items.opportunity: Increased targets for remaining pass-catchers; Goedert/AJB upside.

items.text: Jonah Coleman will be the Broncos RB you wish you had by year end. Roster in 100% of leagues; go fix that.
items.why: Pre-season call repeating; activated and opportunity.

items.text: Lamar Jackson (ankle), Puka Nacua (calf), Breece Hall (quad) statuses crucial to Sunday DFS main slate. Hoping early news. Sneaky important scratches: Brian Robinson, Tyler Warren, Emeka Egbuka.
items.why: Player-specific DFS impact and missed scratches.
items.implication: Pivot plans essential; beneficiaries from sneaky OUTs.
items.opportunity: Role expansion for backups/teammates on those teams.

items.text: Key OUTs: Mike Evans, Deebo Samuel, Davante Adams, Rashee Rice, Jeremiyah Love, David Montgomery, Emeka Egbuka, Tyler Warren, Zach Charbonnet, Brian Robinson.
items.why: Saturday night full injury dump for Sunday slate.
items.implication: Direct fades; clear beneficiary paths in those backfields/receiving corps.
items.opportunity: Bijan full load (BRob out); other RB1s/WR1s elevated.

items.text: Key INs: Josh Jacobs, Quinshon Judkins, Jordan Addison, TJ Hockenson, others including Tank Dell, Jonah Coleman context.
Rico Dowdle and DeShon Elliott both up/active for Steelers in Paris game.
items.implication: Viable if volume there; monitor shares.

items.text: Bucs QB Baker Mayfield returns (was Q); confident play expected.
items.implication: Stabilizes Bucs offense; boosts Godwin/Irving etc.
items.opportunity: Full pass game for TB skill players.

items.text: Rarely buys RB-as-WR hype, but tempted by CMC lining up more in slot amid 49ers dire WR injuries (Evans/Deebo out) and Kaelon Black presence.
items.why: 49ers WR outs create opportunity; CMC smile comment.
items.implication: Potential receiving boost for CMC; elevated floor/ceiling.
items.opportunity: Increased routes/targets in slot for CMC.

items.text: Loves A.J. Brown usage/matchup (WR10 range) vs CHI; strong pass-catcher spot.
items.why: Usage and Bears matchup favorable for yardage.
items.implication: Strong start; elevated with DeVonta out.

items.text: Loves Tucker Kraft (TE buffet) vs DET; Lions allow heavy TE production.
items.why: Lions TE vulnerability; 9 TE TDs allowed recently.
items.opportunity: Red-zone and volume vs soft TE D.

items.text: Loves Jaylen Warren, Chuba Hubbard, Bucky Irving for volume in friendly matchups.
Hates Rome Odunze vs NE shadow (Gonzalez); tough outside matchup, limited upside.
items.why: 90% outside targets; Gonzalez shadow; low floor history.
